fields.name: token
fields.help: Webflow site API token (Site settings > Apps & integrations > API access) or OAuth access token with CMS:read/CMS:write (and authorized_user:read for me).

adapter.terms: Rate limit 60 requests/minute (120 on CMS/Business plans); respect X-RateLimit-Remaining.

me.note: GET /v2/token/authorized_by: the user who authorized the token (id, email, name).

list_items.note: GET /v2/collections/{collection_id}/items?offset&limit (≤100)&name: staged CMS items of the collection (collection is required: a collection id). query filters by exact item name; url is the item slug.

get_item.note: GET /v2/collections/{collection_id}/items/{item_id}: one staged item; content is its fieldData object.

create_item.note: POST /v2/collections/{collection_id}/items {fieldData: {name, slug, …}}: fields is the fieldData (slug is required by Webflow; rich-text fields take HTML), title sets name. The item is staged; publish it with the site/items publish endpoints. content is not sent (field slugs differ per collection).

update_item.note: PATCH /v2/collections/{collection_id}/items/{item_id} {fieldData}: updates the given fields of the staged item.

delete_item.note: DELETE /v2/collections/{collection_id}/items/{item_id}: deletes the staged item (a published copy stays live until unpublished).

not_offered.generate_image: Webflow's Data API has no generation endpoints.
not_offered.generate_video: Webflow's Data API has no generation endpoints.
not_offered.get_job: No generation jobs in the Data API.

evidence: probe: 6/6 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
spec https://raw.githubusercontent.com/webflow/openapi-spec/main/openapi/v2.yml: 6/6 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
